python3 -c '
import numpy as np

xc, yc, th = 0.921, 3.628, np.radians(135.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

legs = [
    (218.0, 416, "front-left"),
    (262.0, 450, "front-center"),
    (294.0, 373, "back-inner"),
    (334.0, 389, "right")
]

coords = []
for u, v, name in legs:
    Zc = f * H / (v - 256.0)
    Xc = (u - 256.0) * H / (v - 256.0)
    Xw = xc + Xc * np.cos(th) + Zc * np.sin(th)
    Yw = yc - Xc * np.sin(th) + Zc * np.cos(th)
    print(f"{name}: Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f} -> World: ({Xw:.3f}, {Yw:.3f})")
    coords.append((Xw, Yw))

xs = [c[0] for c in coords]
ys = [c[1] for c in coords]
print(f"Table center from 4 legs: ({np.mean(xs):.3f}, {np.mean(ys):.3f})")
'
